The star quarterback lit up their secondary as well (with a bit of luck on one touchdown!), but we struggled to stop their powerful running game in the red zone, with their unique player scoring 4 rushing touchdowns. The star quarterback scored the winning touchdown with just 8 seconds left, marking his memorable moment.

3: In a surprising victory, we faced the top-ranked team and won 52-24. We were struggling with a 4-5 record and trying to become bowl eligible, while the opposing team was on a winning streak and aiming for the national championship. We completely dominated the game; everything clicked, and we dismantled them. It was an awesome surprise because I don't think any fan of our team was expecting it!
